title: Concrete Waves
description: Leo faces his anxiety at the local skatepark and discovers community in an unexpected fall.

scenes.narration: Leo wanted to learn to skate, but every time he stepped into the park, the older kids made him freeze.
scenes.visual: Teenage boy standing with a skateboard near concrete ramps looking uncertain in morning light.

scenes.narration: He spent weeks practicing alone in his dimly lit driveway, taking quiet falls on the hard asphalt.
scenes.visual: A young skater practicing balance on a wooden skateboard on a quiet suburban driveway at sunset.

scenes.narration: One afternoon, he finally rolled up to the local bowl, heart hammering against his ribs.
scenes.visual: Close-up of worn skate sneakers stepping onto a grip tape surface of a skateboard.

scenes.narration: His first drop-in was a disaster. The board slipped out, sending him sliding across the concrete on his hands.
scenes.visual: A teenage boy slipping off his skateboard onto smooth concrete inside a sunlit outdoor park.

scenes.narration: Instead of laughing, a girl with a scuffed helmet tossed him his board and showed him where to position his feet.
scenes.visual: A young girl with a helmet offering a hand to a boy sitting on the pavement.

scenes.narration: On his second try, he leaned forward, caught the momentum, and rode out smooth into the open park.
scenes.visual: A teenage boy smoothly riding a skateboard down a curved concrete surface with arms open.

scenes.narration: Every fall is just practice for landing it right. Follow along for more daily real-life stories.
scenes.visual: A happy teenage boy holding his skateboard under his arm smiling towards the camera at dusk.
